name: Nuporanga (Brazil)
description: Quartered white and green by a red cross, with the municipal arms in the upper hoist quarter.
history: Nuporanga is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 5 June 1978 (the municipal symbols, designed by the writer José Aleixo Irmão, were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 627 of 5 June 1978, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown and the motto MAGNAM FACIO PATRIAM
